summary_markdown:
## Outcome
The run delivered a playable original single-file Three.js browser FPS (start briefing, 3 loadouts, HUD with minimap/compass/killfeed/hitmarker, 8 combat bots, ADS/fire/reload, HP plus armor plates, UAV unlock, shrinking zone, win/lose/restart) with 8 Warzone references recorded in PROGRESS.md, headless-Chrome verification with zero console errors, 7 inspected screenshots, a live public tunnel, and status comments on the issue. All workflow steps report success except Delivery, which had not yet run.

## What worked
- Research-first discipline: 8 references with stated purposes guided HUD layout, TTK, and match loop; shipped assets stayed original/procedural.
- Real-artifact verification caught 5 genuine bugs: hitscan spread multiplier making aimed fire always miss, permanent recoil-pitch accumulation, spawn facing a wall, a POI pole filling the spawn view, and favicon 404s. All were fixed and re-verified (10 shots to 4 hits to 1 kill; enemy AI damaging the player unprompted).
- A parallel session's stale-timer (runId guard) repair composed cleanly with the verification fixes; the agent checked the diff and grep counts before committing.
- Deployment evidence was rigorou
prompt_alignment: Define a multi-session file-ownership rule: re-read shared status files before editing and never overwrite another session's evidence sections.
Mandate a fresh-context critic that inspects the running artifact independently; forbid self-verification as the only review.
Require a machine-checkable evidence checklist (entrypoint, tests, screenshots, public URL, issue comment) so completion is accepted on the first attempt.
Require a pre-flight probe of networking, logging, serve command, and deploy path before any implementation work begins.
Require deterministic test hooks and seeded scenarios for gameplay verification rather than live-state-dependent assertions.

skill_recommendations.name: browser-verification
skill_recommendations.reason: No skill covers headless-browser game verification; the agent hand-rolled playwright scripts twice. A reusable harness (deterministic fixtures, state assertions, screenshot matrix) would remove the largest verification cost.

skill_recommendations.name: gauntlet-loop
skill_recommendations.reason: The builder-plus-harsh-critic loop it describes is exactly what this run skipped; prompt should invoke it explicitly for each major piece.

skill_recommendations.name: static-deploy
skill_recommendations.reason: Pages path-layout 404s and npm-start mismatch wasted cycles; a skill documenting static-artifact deploy conventions and pre-checks would prevent repeat friction.
